chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad from Sahl ibn Ziyad by his chain who said:
He (peace be upon him) said: The superiority of the right flanks of the rows over its left flanks is like the superiority of the congregation over the individual prayer.

key_terms.مَيَامِنِ الصُّفُوفِ: the right flanks/sides of the prayer rows

ai.seo_question: What is the religious merit of standing on the right side of the prayer row compared to the left?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* underscores the hierarchical merit of prayer positions, elevating the right side of the row (*mayamin*) above the left (*mayasir*) by comparing it to the superior reward of congregational prayer (*jamāʿah*) over individual prayer (*fard*). In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes a strong preference for filling the right side first, reflecting the communal unity (*tawāṣul*) emphasized in Shia ritual practice. The comparison highlights that spatial alignment within the row carries spiritual weight akin to the collective act of worship itself.
